name: Mzuri Wildlife Foundation Wildlife Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants for grassroots wildlife conservation work such as habitat enhancement and anti-poaching. Applicants send a letter of inquiry first, then are invited to submit a formal application.
reporting: All grantees are required to submit reports on progress achieving the goals, objectives, and outcomes identified in the proposal.

eligibility.rule: Is a tax-exempt nonprofit or has a U.S.-based fiscal sponsor
If an existing grantee, submit prior-year progress reports before more funding

documents: Tax-exemption proof or U.S.-based fiscal sponsor proof

calls.label: Yearly cycle: LOI 15 September, application 1 November

status.quote: Mzuri Wildlife Foundation has one funding cycle each year.

recurring.quote: Letter of Inquiry Deadline September 15 Formal Grant Application Deadline November 1

calls.recurring: Letter of inquiry due 15 September; formal applications due 1 November each year.

effort.quote: Letters of inquiry must be submitted no later than September 15 to be considered for funding in the following year.
Grant applications must be submitted by November 1 to be reviewed in the first quarter of the following calendar year.
